answer.text: AU-EAST had the highest revenue last quarter at about NZD 13.55 million. NZ-NORTH was next at NZD 8.81 million, then NZ-SOUTH at NZD 6.24 million and AU-WEST at NZD 5.83 million.
assumptions: Revenue is net sales after discounts and returns, in NZD (AUD converted at the monthly rate)

sql.sql:
select s.region as region, sum(s.net_amount_nzd) as revenue
from marts.fct_sales as s
where s.order_date between %(start_date)s and %(end_date)s
group by 1
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit %(row_limit)s
